question: The book titled 'Soul of New Machine' was awarded with:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Pulitzer**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• *The Soul of a New Machine* by Tracy Kidder won the **Pulitzer Prize for General Nonfiction** in 1982.
 
• The book provides an in-depth look at the challenges and culture within a computer engineering team as they work to develop a new minicomputer.
 
• It is celebrated for its exploration of technological innovation and the dedication of engineers in the rapidly advancing field of computing.
 
• Pulitzer Prize
 
• The Pulitzer Prize is an American award given for achievements in newspaper, magazine, and online journalism, literature, and musical composition within the United States

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Man Booker Prize**
 
• The Man Booker Prize (now known as the Booker Prize) is awarded for the best original novel written in English and published in the United Kingdom. It primarily focuses on works of fiction rather than nonfiction.
 
• **Neustadt International Prize for Literature**
 
• The Neustadt Prize is a biennial international literary award that recognizes outstanding literary achievement in fiction, poetry, or drama. It is often awarded to writers whose work has had a significant cultural impact but is not typically for nonfiction works on technology.
 
• **Hugo Award**
 
• The Hugo Award is a prestigious award given for the best science fiction or fantasy works and achievements of the previous year. It is not typically awarded for nonfiction works focused on real-world technology or engineering.
